about: The game world's map (game-world.html), as data: a new place is one more entry, no code. Read by js/core/world/places.js (the rules, pure, tested by .github/scripts/js/places.test.mjs). show / open: true, false, or a condition on story state: { flag }, { flag, is }, { quest, step }, { questDone }, { seen }, { choice, is }, { all: [...] }, { any: [...] }, { not: cond }. go: { url } opens a page inside the world, { story: scene id } asks the story engine (#34) to play a scene (game-world.js startStory hook). lockedLine shows while it can be seen but not entered. Owner, Nov 15: built so the story engine adds and unlocks places by data.
